15350|44b49612.name: Horde Warbringer
15350|44b49612.text: War is upon us, $N.  It's time for every member of the Horde to answer the call and join the fight against the cowardly Alliance.

16227|c5ceacbe.name: Bragok
16227|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

259118|b3bb7fbb.name: Muln Earthfury
259118|b3bb7fbb.text: I am Muln Earthfury of the Earthen Ring. What brings you before me today?

263570|8ac1454b.name: Creeg Bothunk
263570|8ac1454b.text: Greetings, traveler! I am Creeg Bothunk, the main supplier for the Darkspear Raiders. As you improve your standing with the Darkspear Raiders, I will be able to provide a variety of goods that you can use inside Darkspear Islands. Should you find yourself in need of item repair, I also provide those services.

264078|adb68b1b.name: Sutara Plainstalker
264078|adb68b1b.text:
It is my honor to handle supply and provisioning for the Earthen Ring. 

My stock is limited at present, but check back with me often and I may have new equipment and supplies available for purchase.

276171|1e85fa3a.name: Oura Stormspinner
276171|1e85fa3a.text: We shen'dorei have need of additional cloth to replenish our supplies. Any donations you make would be put to good use, and surely raise your esteem with the Windshapers.

2995|bfaf54b7.name: Tal
2995|bfaf54b7.text: When mounted on the back of a wind rider, one sees that its reputation for strength and speed is well earned.

3084|5092cb45.name: Bluffwatcher
3084|5092cb45.text: Tepa is renown for her clothwork.  She can be found at Thunder Bluff Armorers on the middle rise.

3310|cc0cf280.name: Doras
3310|cc0cf280.text: You haven't lived until you've looked down on the world from the back of a wind rider.

3442|c0ad1190.name: Sputtervalve
3442|c0ad1190.text: Lots to do, lots to do! The Union's given us deadlines and they're not the sort you want to miss!

5882|f341dff7.name: Pephredo
5882|f341dff7.text: Greetings, $c.  Are you here to learn of the hidden arts?

96241-complete.name: Mazu'kon
96241-complete.text:
Heh... when I said unique properties, I wasn't kiddin' mon! You seem no worse for wear, so it be all good.

Thank you for your aid, $c. It be much appreciated.
96241-complete.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96241-progress.name: Mazu'kon
96241-progress.text: Did ya get what I need?
96241-progress.title: Talkin' bout Toxins, Mon

96259-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96259-complete.text: Thank you for your service to the people of this land. It may take time for us to completely clear out the infestation, but your efforts have created a stable foothold for us to leverage against these vile creatures.
96259-complete.title: Defending the Dead

96260-complete.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-complete.text:
These are excellent samples, and more than sufficient for my needs.

Here, take this. I was able to craft a rather unique cloak with a weave I spun from the small sample of silk already in my possession. I am hopeful that you will find it useful in your travels.

Earthmother watch over you, $c.
96260-complete.title: Stronger than Steel

96260-progress.name: Yorn Grimtotem
96260-progress.text: This silk's remarkable properties could be used to make lightweight, durable cloth with remarkable defensive properties. I am eager to experiment with more of it.
96260-progress.title: Stronger than Steel

96261-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96261-complete.text:
Reanimated dead? The broodmother possessing a night elven form? These are troubling revelations. One has to wonder what it all means... I fear that must be a concern for a later time.

Thank you, $N. You've done the Earthen Ring and the people of Mulgore a great service.
96261-complete.title: The Broodmother

96294-accept.name: Unknown
96294-accept.text:
<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.

You notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>
96294-accept.title: A Darker Truth

96294-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
96294-complete.text:
This is... most disturbing. Why would a druid be behind a brood of dangerous spiders? Who or what is this "Wild King" and "Pact" that is referenced in this letter?

I will confer with the druids of the Cenarion Circle on this. Perhaps they will know more.

Thank you again for your aid. As disturbing as this information is, we will rest easier knowing that the person controlling these vile creatures has been destroyed.
96294-complete.title: A Darker Truth

98823-complete.name: Muln Earthfury
98823-complete.text:
Ah... this shard hums with the voice of the world itself. The light within is a memory from the past, glimmering with flashes of history. This titan machine must have been waiting to be understood for lifetimes.

You've done wisely to bring it to us. The Earthen Ring will safeguard it, study it, and share the truths it keeps when we are able to receive its messages.

You honor the elements today, traveler.
98823-complete.title: Earthen Echo

98888-complete.name: Horde Warbringer
98888-complete.text: Well done, $c! You've helped the Horde gain control of Darkspear Islands!
98888-complete.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98888-progress.name: Horde Warbringer
98888-progress.text: The fight in Darkspear Islands is ceaseless, $N. Together, we will destroy the Alliance dogs in the Theramore Expeditionary Force!
98888-progress.title: Conflict at Darkspear Islands

98906-complete.name: Nizook Boof
98906-complete.text: You be showin' strength and dedication out at the Darkspear Islands! Your prowess in battle are to be admired, mon!
98906-complete.title: The Battle for Darkspear Islands!

99196-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99196-progress.text:
The Windshapers are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.

A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Windshapers for your generosity. 

If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99196-progress.title: A Donation of Wool

99197-progress.name: Oura Stormspinner
99197-progress.text:
The Windshapers presently find ourselves in need of silk cloth. If you could spare sixty pieces of silk then we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A fine gift such as silk would certainly increase your honor and esteem amongst the Windshapers!

If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
99197-progress.title: A Donation of Silk
